title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Pay Dispute and Adjustment Limits by Batch Type
content:
Pay disputes and pay adjustments on Cartwise Shopper Batches are bounded per batch type by a dispute window, a minimum amount, a cap on a single adjustment the agent may approve and a count of adjustments per shopper in a rolling 30 days.

| Batch type | Dispute window (calendar days after completion) | Smallest shortfall handled as a dispute (USD) | Largest single adjustment the agent may approve (USD) | Adjustments the agent may approve per shopper in a rolling 30 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Batch | 7 | 1.00 | 10.00 | 3 |
| Express 30 Batch | 7 | 1.00 | 15.00 | 3 |
| Single Delivery Batch | 7 | 1.00 | 15.00 | 3 |
| Double Delivery Batch | 7 | 1.00 | 20.00 | 3 |
| Triple Delivery Batch | 7 | 1.00 | 25.00 | 3 |
| Stock-Up Batch | 10 | 1.00 | 30.00 | 3 |

Larger adjustments, and adjustments beyond the 30-day count, are escalated rather than approved by the agent.

## Controlled adjustment reasons

| Batch type | Reasons a pay adjustment can carry |
|---|---|
| Shop-Only Batch | shown-pay shortfall; heavy pay missing; wait pay missing; boost missing; cancellation pay missing |
| Express 30, Single Delivery, Double Delivery, Triple Delivery and Stock-Up Batch | shown-pay shortfall; mileage underpaid; heavy pay missing; wait pay missing; boost missing; cancellation pay missing; return pay missing |

The Shop-Only Batch has no mileage-underpaid and no return-pay-missing reason.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical adjustment of 22.40 on a Triple Delivery Batch is within the 25.00 cap; the same 22.40 on a Double Delivery Batch is above its 20.00 cap.
